answer: Divergent-Response Capability Proof. Each identity must answer a fresh random challenge whose two valid answers require opposite internal states, then commit the answer hash on-chain. A clone cannot hold both states at once, so producing a second valid divergence for the same seed fails. Honest agents pay one cheap signing and a copper-level gas fee; an attacker pays a full independent re-derivation and state setup per clone, plus the sunk pigment cost of every divergence proof already bound to that seed. Nectar, the small per-identity deposit refunded on honest exit,
